name: Trinity League India Limited
about: Trinity League India Limited operates in the management and financial consultancy business in India. It offers advice, services, and consultancy across various fields. The company also engages in remote sensing, geographic information systems (GIS), agricultural initiatives, and water resource activities. In addition, it explores, manufactures, markets, and distributes Hydrogel, a potassium- and starch-based agricultural product. The company was formerly known as Dr. Wellman's Homoeopathic Laboratory Ltd. and changed its name to Trinity League India Limited in July 2012. Trinity League India Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Noida, India.
